name: Clearing
description: A mossy clearing ringed by gnarled oaks. A crumbling stone gatehouse stands to the north. A narrow path winds east into the trees. To the south, you notice a faint trail leading back toward civilization.

name: Gatehouse Arch
description: You pass beneath a sagging arch of grey stone. Iron hinges, long since emptied of their gates, flank the passage. The courtyard lies ahead to the north. The clearing is back to the south.

name: Outer Courtyard
description: A broad courtyard choked with weeds. A collapsed well sits at the centre. The keep's main door is set into the north wall — heavy oak banded with iron, sealed with a heavy lock. A narrow stair climbs the east wall. The gatehouse arch is to the south.

name: Great Hall
description: A vast, barrel-vaulted hall. Tattered banners hang from iron rings overhead. A long table of black oak runs down the centre, set with the ruins of a feast no one ever ate. Dust lies thick on everything. Stairs at the far end lead down. The courtyard door is to the south.

name: Wall Walk
description: A narrow battlement running along the east wall. You can see for miles — farmland, a distant river, the dark smudge of Hallow Forest. The stair back down is to the west. An old iron chest sits wedged in a crenel.

name: The Undercroft
description: A low, vaulted cellar that smells of damp stone and old wood. Empty wine racks line the walls. A single oil lantern in a wall sconce provides unsteady light. Stairs lead back up to the great hall.

name: Woodcutter's Path
description: A faint track between ancient oaks. Pale mushrooms cluster at their roots. The clearing is back to the west. A hollow tree to the east is big enough to enter.

name: Inside the Hollow Tree
description: The interior of an enormous oak, hollowed by decades of rot. It smells of earth and something faintly sweet. Light filters through a gap overhead. A narrow opening leads back west.

name: Town Gate
description: You stand at the weathered gate marking the boundary of the keep's lands. Stone pillars rise on either side, carved with the faded tower crest of Thornwall. The overgrown path back into the keep and its clearing lies to the north. Ahead to the south, the familiar warmth of civilization and the welcoming lights of the town beckon.
